notes:
• Friends: sign in with Google, pick a username, and add friends by @username. A weekly board shows everyone's Forge Score, workouts and status, with a nudge button for friends who haven't finished their week.
• Shared streaks: count the weeks you and a friend both hit your targets. See them on Home under your streak and in each friend's card.
• New tab order: Home, Friends, Workouts, Food, Progress.
• Privacy: only your weekly summary is shared, never your sets or meals. Turn off your photo or PRs any time in Settings.
